text.p: Diagnostic Health Services Inc said on Monday it completed the acquisition of four hospital-based magnetic resonance imaging operations from Diagnostic Imaging Services Inc for $13 million.

"The acquisition of these hospital-based MRI operations not only solidifies our position as a provider of outsourced radiology/cardiology diagnostic and departmental management services, but also represents an exciting opportunity to continue the expansion of our capabilities," Chairman Max Batzer said.
The company paid a combination of cash, deferred payments and assumed operating asset related liabilities.
Diagnostic Health Services provides medical outsourcing services to hospitals, physicians' offices and other healthcare facilities.
